material_systems.name: Semi-Transparent Penetrating Stain
material_systems.notes: Professional standard for deck restaining (~60% of work). Iron oxide UV pigments, penetrating chemistry. 2 coats on RP (weathered wood absorbs more than new). Same product system as NC. No primer required — penetrating product.

material_systems.name: Semi-Solid Stain
material_systems.notes: Heavy-pigment penetrating stain with thin film build. 2 coats mandatory. Good for covering wear patterns and color variation on RP surfaces. No primer required.

material_systems.name: Solid Color Deck Stain
material_systems.notes: Film-forming coating — opaque color, complete grain masking. DELAMINATION RISK on horizontal surfaces. RP WARNING: over existing solid stain adds film thickness, compounding moisture entrapment. Tannin-blocking primer conditional on cedar/redwood when applied over bare wood after stripping.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Incompatible Existing Coatings
material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Required when applying stain over unknown or paint-type existing coating. Bonding primer bridges the incompatible coating adhesion gap. NOT needed for stain-over-stain. Conditional activation based on assessment results.

material_systems.name: Deck Cleaner / Stripper (Alkaline)
material_systems.notes: Sodium percarbonate or sodium hydroxide-based. Step 1 of chemical restoration. RP may require stronger formulation for multi-layer existing coatings. Must be neutralized with acid brightener.

material_systems.name: Wood Brightener (Oxalic / Citric Acid)
material_systems.notes: Oxalic acid (cedar/redwood tannin) or citric acid. Step 2 of chemical restoration after stripping. Neutralizes alkaline residue, restores natural wood color. Also used standalone on cedar/redwood for tannin management.

consumables.name: 60-grit sandpaper (belt or disc)
consumables.notes: Aggressive grit for heavy coating removal on floor. Belt sander or random orbital.

consumables.name: 80-grit sandpaper (belt or disc)
consumables.notes: Standard prep grit for sanding between coats or scuffing existing. Hand sand for railings/spindles.

consumables.name: 100-grit sandpaper (hand sand)
consumables.notes: Fine hand sand for spindle finish prep.

consumables.name: 4-inch stiff bristle stain brush
consumables.notes: Primary floor brush. Stiff natural bristle for penetrating stains, synthetic for solid stain.

consumables.name: 2-inch stain brush
consumables.notes: Detail brush for railings, spindles, and stair steps.

consumables.name: Lamb's wool stain pad applicator
consumables.notes: Pad applicator on extension pole for floor staining.

consumables.name: Roller cover 3/8-1/2 inch nap (stain)
consumables.notes: Short nap for solid stain roller application.

consumables.name: Airless spray tip (stain, 515-519)
consumables.notes: Wider fan tip for stain vs paint. Lower pressure to reduce atomization.

consumables.name: Blue painters tape (1.5 inch)
consumables.notes: Siding edge tape at ledger board. Fixture masking tape.

consumables.name: Plastic sheeting (4 mil poly)
consumables.notes: Siding cover for spray_backbrush. Landscape protection below elevated deck.

consumables.name: Canvas drop cloth (4x15 ft)
consumables.notes: Non-slip hardscape protection for crew traffic areas.

consumables.name: Pump sprayer (2 gallon) for chemical application
consumables.notes: Chemical stripper and brightener application. Reusable tool tracked as consumable.

consumables.name: Stiff bristle deck scrub brush on pole
consumables.notes: Scrub brush for stripper agitation. Also used for back-brushing after spray.

consumables.name: ASTM D3359 cross-hatch adhesion test kit
consumables.notes: RP-specific consumable. Cross-hatch knife and tape for adhesion testing per ASTM D3359.

consumables.name: Replacement pins for pin-type moisture meter
consumables.notes: Pins wear on exterior wood. Track as consumable.
